connector.name: Swarm At
connector.registryDescription: Settlement protocol for AI agent swarms - hash-chained ledger, trust, 48 blueprints, 18 tools
connector.summary: Hosted at api.swarm.at over server sent events, also runs locally from the Python package swarm-at-sdk. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mediaeater account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
